reply.text: This is a pain question, so it's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach. An ache in the elbow is something a clinician should look at before we decide anything about your training. I'm glad to keep building the rest of your work around it once they've given you the go-ahead, and if you tell me what they say to avoid, I'll plan around that. In the meantime, let's keep the conversation on the training side: if you want, I can pull up your recent pull-up sessions so we can see how the volume has been trending.
